bestBets.overview: TAKE THE FIELD mixes form but best is good enough. HALF TIME SIREN wasn't beaten far latest and will only need to hold form to go close again. DARK OPAL will find this easier than past couple and can improve sharply. LADY MAYFLOWER wouldn't shock if can find best. MINOZZA next best.

raceTips.comment:
HALF TIME SIREN is the one improving as he races throughout the dirt season. Went around $60-1 only two starts ago when beaten 3 lengths here at Port Hedland before just getting done by Blatant Violation (previously put in a good C1 Carnarvon race). They cleared with 5 lengths back to third. Alex Hearn on in a positive ride, think he is actually hard to beat here.
DARK OPAL drops from a pair of Class 1's back into a Maiden and that is always a recipe for market support. Awkward draw for the travelling Apprentice of the Year in Holly Nottle,
TAKE THE FIELD will look to be leaders back or three back the fence - happy to forgive the Roebourne run and look at his prior sescond placings here at Hedland
MINOZZA next best.

bestBets.overview: IMPERIALIZE is a consistent type and must be rated highly. CALATHINITE mixes form but best is good enough. MRS KANGAROO wasn't beaten far latest and will only need to hold form to go close again. LA SIGNORA DANE mixes form but best is good enough. DENVER AFFAIR wouldn't shock on best form, keep safe.

raceTips.comment:
IMPERIALIZE has been racing well of late, only beaten by the all conquering Immortal Shield last start and Red Rebel who came out and won a stronger race at Canarvon on Friday. Can lead this or sit just off if taken on. Looks the one to beat.
LA SIGNORA DANE was beaten 2.5lengths by this galloper two starts ago and gets a 2kg swing but also drawns underneath. Does Holly look to hold up at all costs? 
DENVER AFFAIR is flying - won a C1 three starts back, maintained a close to 6 wide run at Carnarvon to finish second and then a complete forgive at Roebourne last start. Will be giving our two leaders a good head start though.
CALATHINITE maps for every chance with a nice 3kg claim in the saddle.

bestBets.overview: TORQUED UP hit the line well latest and will appreciate the rsie in trip. PLAYING QUEST mixes form but best is good enough. LEADING TADDY is a consistent type who will make presence felt as usual. KIA ORA TATOU looks well placed and must be respected. MAGIC SHOT looks the knockot hope if gains a start.

raceTips.comment:
PLAYING QUEST is now third up on the dirt and looks to be the improver. Half the field met in the Harding Cup 8 days ago and I thought his effort wasnt disgraceful considering he never got into the race, barely anyone could make ground down the outside and his prior run first up at Carnarvon had some merit. Can settle midfield here and be close enough on straightening.
CHEDDAR BOB goes around a decent prie for a galloper who races on pace and likely finds it today without too much pressure. Beat home Playing Quest last start when not finding a lot of room in the straight (nor its favourite position out in front).
WING IT doesnt travel into his races and he was able to get away with it in C1 and Maiden Grade. He's being found out now up in grade, but when he puts his mind on the job he can rattle of a serious sectional
KIA ORA TATOU maps to be up on pace - rule a line through last start.

bestBets.overview: ANOTHER NEPHEW will find this easier than last start and can improve sharply. OSCAR WINNER mixes form but best is good enough. MYSTICAL MAN wouldn't shock if can find best form. HUNDRED YARDS looks better suited back to 1600m and must be rated highly. BIG KARRI won well latest and can go on with it here. HOLDOUT is a consistent type who will make presence felt as usual. MY DE GRECE wasn't beaten far latest and will only need to hold form to go close again.

raceTips.comment:
Could be called the consolation Cup with the runners engaged here. What a great (and tricky) affair we have with multiple runners being able to take this out.
Simply cant go past My De Grece - in her last 4 starts she has had 2 ripper runs and 2 dissapointments. Jess Gray has been with the grey on both times she has smashed the line and hoping we can repeat here today. 
ANOTHER NEPHEW comes out of the Roebourne Cup where he didnt stay, back to the mile is a huge plus, winner of the Marble Bar Cup and beat most of these back on June 20.
HUNDRED YARDS appeared to jar up at Roebourne - start prior he went down to (Carnarvon) horse of the year in Only Us by a nostril. Repeats that while leading here and likely wins.
OSCAR WINNER beat some of these two starts back. 
Cracking race.

bestBets.overview: GALAXY AFFAIR has won 3 of last 4 starts and must be rated highly. BORDER CONTROL won well latest and can go on with it here. STAR POWER has won 2 of last 3 and in suitable company must be respected. HIT THE JACKPOT will find this easier than last start and can improve sharply. FAVOURED is knocking on the door and is due for a change of luck. BARTIME is rarely far away and that should be no different here. ROYALZEL wouldn't shock on best form, keep safe.

raceTips.comment:
ROYALZEL was beaten by GALAXY AFFAIR last time they met but he doesnt need to get back to last today and he attacked the line strongly when going around all horses while his rival was able to cut the corner and find the gaps (albeit under 62kg!)
BORDER CONTROL has been building all season and took out the Settler's Sprint with an excellently timed run to run down The Coolakin Kid. 
GALAXY AFFAIR has won carrying 64.5 - the weight wont worry him and its another excellent chance for Tara Atherden.
HIT THE JACKPOT your likely leader but could be a few lengths of the top three.

bestBets.overview: ZADAR ROCK off back to back wins will prove hard to beat again. DYNAMIC ONE wasn't beaten far latest and will only need to hold form to go close again. MANAVENDRA off a last start palcing must be rated highly. STAR TESTYMONY is knocking on the door and is due for a change of luck. GAMBLER'S GOLD looks the knockout hope now out to 2200m.

raceTips.comment:
What a Port Hedland Cup we have here. The top 3 at the weights and in the market is exactly where you want to be looking. My heart says ZADAR ROCK - what an absolute dirt champion this bloke is. This is tough though. He will have to lump 63kg and come from near last. He beat home MANAVENDRA last start by 2.5 lengths but that galloper was having his second dirt start and was 1600m up to the 2200m. Has to be some improvement of that run?
And then we have DYNAMIC ONE - he won the first two of his prep over much shorter distances carrying 62 and 64.5. The camp were clearly targeting this race by giving him a mid prep break, trialled over the 1200m and then stepped him up to the 2000m when being beaten by ZADAR ROCK by a length. Gets 3.5kg on him and surely improves of that effort again. Cracking race.
Going with DYNAMIC ONE. Will roll forward find a spot and try and pinch it.
MANAVENDRA can turn the tables after the run in the Roebourne Cup. 
ZADAR ROCK in for third - if he wins I'll still be cheering.
STAR TESTYMONY in for forth.

bestBets.overview: ESQUEL is knocking on the door and is due for a change of luck. RAY'S SAUCE has won 2 of last 3 starts and must be rated highly. CASSENITE wasn't beaten far latest and will only need to hold form to go close again. MY TEA mixes form but best is good enough. CHANTILLY GIRL is a consistent type who will make presence felt as usual. OUR SHILLAYLEIGH wouldn't shock if gains a start.

raceTips.comment:
Geez good luck in the get out here. Throw a dart.
Landed on CASSENITE with Tash on board. Drawn a gate to settle midfield at worst and has a nice closing turn of foot. Has been wide and working at her last few and could be the map horse here.
HEEZA BEAU is easily roughie of the day. Map him to sit close to leaders back here - his first two runs this season would take care of this field.
TASSORT WE WANT hasnt been able to find the front and that has meant we haven't seen the same horse that beat Another Nephew. Even if he jumps here, I'm not sure she isn't three wide.
RAY'S SAUCE (is a race horse - get it?) - I didnt for quite some time but he has revelled in the dirt this season. Wide gate and 61kg are levellers. 
Good luck.
